why: A here-document body is data for the program it feeds, and commands only when a shell reads it. Both sides run on new issues with a bot token and no permissions block. The pass side, not applicable because it starts no agent, writes a welcome note through cat, and the note mentions an agent command in backticks; the review measured that shape taken for an agent launch in a real workflow. The fail side feeds the same kind of body to bash, whose line starts the agent CLI. Whoever reads every body line as a command fails the pass side; whoever skips every body passes the fail side.
